objectives.text: Count a group of up to 10 real objects by touching each one
Identify the written numbers 1 through 10 in order
Explain that the last counted number tells how many objects are in the group
Combine two groups of real objects to form a single group
Count all the objects in the combined group to find the total sum
Describe putting groups together as addition
Count real objects grouped in sets of 5 using touch and tally
Identify the number pattern ending in 0 and 5 on a hundred chart
Explain how counting by 5s is faster than counting by 1s
Model two-digit addition problems using base-ten blocks to group tens and ones.
Explain when and how to regroup 10 ones into 1 ten.
Solve vertical addition equations that require regrouping in the ones place.
